workaround.result: own HEAD + own index, so nothing can lag
workaround.note: A worktree is immune, because it has its own HEAD as well as its own index.

tip.result: both sessions share HEAD; .git/index belongs to the repo, not the session

tray.result: private index trades a visible collision for silent data loss

bank.surface: stale private index vs new HEAD
bank.result: lacks the other's add → delete; holds pre-commit blob → revert; exit 0

point: A spoiled index is not a hold. Score the spoil or admit banked. A linked worktree is immune, not the hold.
